answer: Identity is bound to a signed provenance chain, so a copycat wallet behaves as a mirror with no history and cannot inherit reputation. To mitigate sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit that decays unless it continuously performs verifiable work, like carving a canyon one layer at a time. Forging a thousand puppets costs real capital and the timber of repeated epoch losses, since withheld stake is slashed on every failed audit. Attackers thus pay linearly while honest participants pay once. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
